title: Looking for the Falls
author: Ming Cao
description: I followed Enfield Creek downstream through Enfield Glen, New York, to see how a series of waterfalls appears in a river’s elevation profile. The animation links each highlighted drop in the profile to the same reach on the map, showing where the creek descends in steps.

media.label: View animation
media.alt: Looking for the Falls: animation linking the Enfield Creek channel map with its longitudinal elevation profile, highlighting successive elevation drops while moving downstream.
